_comment: Optional authorization config. '_roles' defines the deployment's role vocabulary (each role: 'superuser' true/false and/or a default-action 'allow' list); entries override/extend the built-ins additively (admin=all, editor=read+create+update, viewer=read), and any role not listed keeps its built-in default. '_default' governs UNLISTED tables: cellar fails CLOSED, so a table with no entry below is DENIED unless '_default' is "allow" (string) or {"allow":true}/{"deny":false} (object). This sample sets "allow" to keep the permissive built-in/_roles fallback for the demo tables; PRODUCTION should use "_default":"deny" and list every exposed table explicitly. Top-level keys other than '_roles'/'_default'/'_comment' are table names. A table action may be a role array, or an object {roles, owner_column}. owner_column enforces row-level ownership: non-superuser callers only see/modify rows whose owner_column equals their user id, and create forces it to the caller. Superusers bypass both role and row checks.
